w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: Word gets around the haven. Whatever that thing was — the haven's talking about nothing else.
Back at the haven the argument starts: Chris is calling it "The Big Beast." Nobody agrees yet — weigh in if you want.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
📺 SYSTEM: "CONTEST: Windfall. A storm dropped a fortune — fruit, game, a stranded fish haul — and every bit of it is rotting on camera. Beat the rot: eat, dry, haul. The clock is spoilage."

loss.line: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.
